text:
sam: Quick heads-up 11 Blueleaf is asking for a POC to validate swapping from CompetitorZ. They want parity on chat + function-calls, a clear hosted vs dedicated TCO, and completed vendor security questionnaire. Who takes point?

priya: I can lead sales coordination. Two clarifying Qs: do they require identical response tokens/stop-sequence behavior, or are they OK with minor sampling differences? Also timeline?

dan: They said 'behavior must be indistinguishable in 95% of cases' per legal. Timeline: 45 days to decision. Traffic profile: 25 qps steady, 150 burst, median convo length ~1800 tokens.

leah: For parity we should offer two POC variants: (A) quick-proxy (request/response mapping only) — ~3 days; (B) deep-shim (tokenization + stop-seq + function-call mapping) 11 ~2 weeks but much higher fidelity. Recommend B for legal SLA.

priya: Noted. Procurement also wants cost delta modeling vs CompetitorZ including tokenization differences and token billing alignment. Can SE provide a per-100k-request example?

dan: SE can. I'll run a small harness with their prompt set. If we enable KV/prefix caching in Dedicated, expect ~10% token reduction on convo flows. Add that to TCO.

leah: Security checklist posted by Blueleaf: SAML SSO, customer-managed KMS, cert rotation policy, quarterly pen tests, log retention 12 months, and support for IP allowlist. They also attached a 40-question vendor questionnaire.

security-bot: Note: Redwood template answers for vendor questionnaires available at /docs/vendor-qna. SOC2 + ISO27001 are a yes. KMS options: Hosted vault (no tenant key), Dedicated (bring-your-own-KMS), Private (HSM support).

priya: Action items: (1) Dan to run compat harness and share first-diff report (2) Leah to propose adapter implementation plan + ETA (3) Security to populate questionnaire and architecture diagram (4) Sales to build pricing delta + migration incentive.

dan: Working on harness now. Sample smoke call I'll run against our compat emulator:```bash
curl -X POST "https://staging.redwood.ai/compat/v1/complete" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $POC_KEY" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"model":"comp-z-compat","input":"Extract entities and call function if intent==pay"}'
```

leah: FYI: CompetitorZ uses different stop token semantics for JSON-only outputs which causes unclosed JSON about 3% of the time. Our normalization layer trims trailing tokens and enforces JSON schema; we'll include that in the shim.

priya: Good catch. That 3% is likely the legal/QA showstopper. If we can show post-normalization parity to <1% delta, procurement will be happy.

security-bot: For the questionnaire, upload answers to the shared drive and flag any 'No' answers. If KMS is required for Hosted in contract, legal will need to approve; default Hosted does NOT provide tenant-managed keys.

priya: Sales note: propose 3 options for them: 1) Hosted w/ migration credit (fastest) 2) Dedicated reserved capacity (SLA + BYOK) 3) Private deployment (air-gapped) with professional services. Attach explicit $/month numbers + example invoices.

dan: ETA: I'll have initial diff report + sample logs by tomorrow EOD. Will include token counts and top-10 prompts with highest variance.

leah: I'll sketch the shim roadmap: discovery -> mapping rules -> tokenizer adapter -> function-call wiring -> QA harness -> customer smoke. Estimate 10 dev days + 3 QA days.

priya: Decision checkpoint: deliverables due in 10 business days: compat report, completed questionnaire draft, pricing sheet, and proposed POC scope. Can everyone commit?

dan: Yes.

leah: Yes, ping me for sample failing cases.

security-bot: Deploy scheduled: compat-emulator -> staging on 2023-11-02T09:00Z :white_check_mark:

priya: Thanks team 11 I'll schedule a stakeholder call with Blueleaf for next week and request their canonical prompt bundle. I'll post calendar invite.
